Hours of operation

Open, heated. Its page gives hours with no dates, and its only brochure is last summer’s, so they aren’t on the calendar yet.

What a swimmer runs into on the current page
  • The hours on the page carry no dates; class registration dates on the page are January to April 2026.
  • The “Brochure” button opens the Summer 2026 brochure. The contact email is the Green Meadows pool’s.

Admission

Infant (0–2)Free
Children (3–17)$1.00
Adults (18–49)$4.00
50 and up$1.00
Persons with disabilities$1.00
Summer Youth Pass$10
Adult Lap Swim Pass, 30 entries$88
Youth, 50+ and persons with disabilities pass, 30 entries$25
Cash only at the pool. Passes are for year-round pools.
